title: The Four Axioms, Taken Cold

canonical_node.axiom: A1: Something exists. A2: Difference is real. A3: Distinguishable things interact lawfully. A4: Some states rank above others.
definitions: Existence: the brute given that something is, not nothing.
Distinction: a real difference between this and not-this; a registrable difference is a bit.
Relation: lawful interaction between distinguishable things, repeatable and regular.
Orientation: a ranking of states on at least one real gradient (e.g., signal above noise, truth above error).
derivation: A1 is presupposed by any argument, since arguments exist.
A2 is presupposed by measurement, thought, and the sentence itself.
A3 is presupposed by induction and all laboratory practice; it cannot be grounded in experiment.
A4 is presupposed by any inquiry that values truth over error; denying it uses it.
From A1-A4, the track derives a chain of results (01A-04A) claimed to be valid and checkable.
canonical_node.action: Run the A-track series using only these four axioms, with no theological vocabulary, and derive the chain of results (01A-04A) in a checkable manner.
boundary: Does not answer why there is something rather than nothing.
Does not derive an 'ought' from an 'is'.
Does not ask why the four axioms cohere; that is left to a companion series.
Does not use theological vocabulary or religious claims as load-bearing.
test: Check that no theological vocabulary appears in any A-sheet.
Check that every citation is to philosophy, mathematics, or physics.
Check that every conclusion survives a reader who rejects all religious claims.
Check that no hidden fifth axiom is doing secret work.
Check that each derivation step is valid under the stated definitions.

dg1_dependencies: No prior axioms; these are the foundational axioms of the track.
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a minimal axiomatic basis (four axioms) for a parallel track that claims to derive a chain of results without theological assumptions.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the ability to reason about existence, distinction, relation, and orientation without invoking religious or theological premises.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: If any axiom is removed, the claimed derivations in the track lose their foundation; the track cannot proceed as specified.

classification.recommended_atom_action: preserve as foundational charter; do not treat as proven derivation

overstatement_risks: Claims that the chain is 'valid' and 'forced' without providing the actual derivations in this document.
Claims that anyone who has measured, argued, or called a claim false accepts the axioms, which may overstate universality.
The phrase 'everything after this line is derivation' may imply more rigor than is shown.
kill_conditions: A fifth hidden axiom found doing secret work in any derivation.
A broken derivation step under the same definitions.
Smuggled theological or interpretive vocabulary in an A-sheet.
risk.lean_target: Formalize the four axioms and the derivation chain in a proof assistant (e.g., Lean) to verify the claimed validity.

plain_summary: This document is a charter for a parallel track that starts from four stated axioms (existence, distinction, relation, orientation) and claims to derive a chain of results without theological assumptions. It explicitly refuses to answer why the axioms cohere and leaves that to a companion series. The document does not provide the actual derivations, only the roadmap, so the claims of validity are not yet established.
